title: GOOSE devkit installed and frames rendered on macOS Apple Silicon
dataset: GOOSE 3D validation split, archive downloaded 2026-08-22 from goose-dataset.de
sensor_configuration: Velodyne Alpha Prime 128-channel roof LiDAR only, as distributed in the annotated archive
annotation_schema: GOOSE 64-class pointwise semantic labels, SemanticKITTI .label format
conditions: One summer frame (2022-07-22_flight) and one winter frame with snow (2022-12-07_aying_hills)

environment.hardware: No CUDA device. Integrated GPU only.

notes: Satisfies DZ-2's acceptance test that a single frame is visualised locally. Visualisation needs no CUDA; only the Pointcept/PTv3 baselines do, which is recorded separately as 0005. Three install gotchas found and documented in the survey section 6: the devkit viewer expects labels_challenge/ but the archive ships labels/; the bundled 8-class BGR colour map silently mis-renders the 64-class labels; and scans and labels do not share a filename stem.
